prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds t revealed
in earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- The amounts are final thresholds as they were revealed: they already contain whatever
  deductible, VAT and customary-price judgement applied in those cases, and they were computed
  from the full invoiced quantity (the whole quantity was indemnified there). For an
  indemnified line of this type take the stated amount for the line as t as it stands and give
  a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. Do not deduct a deductible from it and do not
  cut the invoiced quantity.
- Deviate only for something this case has and those cases did not: an aggregate cap or
  sub-limit that the lines of this invoice must share, a percentage reduction for a breached
  duty, or a purchase price or sum insured stated in the claim that limits the line.
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only says how often this line type was paid at all. A line type
  that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies do not carry;
  treat it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 1 "Filling valve (internal frost-burst fitting)": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per pc about 52 (80% range 38 to 79); revealed per pc: 48-55 (case 16)
- line 2 "Connection hose": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per pc about 30 (80% range 22 to 45); revealed per pc: 27-33 (case 16)
- line 3 "Senior installer hours": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per hr about 97 (80% range 69 to 131); revealed per hr: >=91 (case 16), so this line (3 hr) about 290 (208 to 393)
- line 5 "Vehicle costs": indemnified in 7 of 16 earlier cases, t = 0 in 9; when indemnified t per pc about 77 (80% range 65 to 88); revealed per pc: >=60 (case 16), >=68 (case 18), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), 34-45 (case 23)

items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4(b) and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like replacement of the fractured valve. One valve is estimated at €52 gross.
Section 7.1.9 covers connection elements that need renewal with the valve. One standard hose is estimated at €30 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover necessary plumbing labour. Three hours at approximately €97 per hour give a rounded whole-line estimate of €290.

Sections 7.1.7(e) and 7.1.9 cover consumables actually used on the fitting repair, but section 3.6(c) excludes general tools and small equipment. Allow €9 gross if the charge is for repair consumables.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 cover one attendance for the insured fitting repair. The gross estimate for that attendance is €77; no separate return visit is billed.

Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging used to locate the confirmed internal escape. Allow €55 gross for equipment use, separate from labour and attendance; the €2,500 event cap does not bind.
Sections 2.1(d), 2.6.4 and 3.5 exclude external frost damage unless the option is scheduled, and none is shown. No internal escape reached the facade, so section 2.4.3 does not restore cover.
Section 3.5(b) excludes removal of render loosened by uninsured external frost. The payable threshold is €0.
Section 3.5(b) excludes rebuilding the substrate beneath render damaged by uninsured external frost. The payable threshold is €0.
The underlying facade damage is excluded by section 3.5, and section 7.1.10 does not allow even a like-for-like contribution when the principal work is uninsured. The payable threshold is €0.
Section 3.5(b) excludes preparing and re-forming the substrate for uninsured facade work. The payable threshold is €0.
Section 3.5(b) excludes the finish coats on the uninsured facade regardless of their number. The payable threshold is €0.
Sections 7.1.5–7.1.6 do not extend cover to separate undamaged elevations for visual matching. The payable threshold is €0.
Section 3.5(b) expressly excludes priming for repairs to render damaged by uninsured external frost. The payable threshold is €0.
Sections 3.5(c) and 7.1.11 exclude labour attributable to uninsured facade work. None of the five hours is payable.
Sections 3.5(c) and 7.1.12 exclude lump sums for uninsured facade work; no covered work is identified on this line. The payable threshold is €0.
